title: Genomic DNA Extraction for Epigenetics Using Spin Columns
author: Muhammad Abbas
materials: M ix thoroughly by vortexing and incubate at 56°C until the tissue is completely lysed. Vortex occasionally during incubation to disperse the sample or place in a thermomixer, shaking water bath or on a rocking platform. Lysis time varies depending on the type of tissue processed. Lysis is usually complete in 1–3 h (Soft tissues) or, for hard tissues, 6–8 h. If it is more convenient, samples can be lysed overnight; this will not affect them adversely.

steps.title: Weigh and freeze tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh 100–300 mg of tissue on an analytical balance, wrap in foil, and flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Crush frozen tissue
steps.instruction: Using a pestle and mortar or a hammer, crush the frozen tissue; for elastic tissues (meniscus, cartilage) mince with a scalpel before freezing.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 100–300 mg of the crushed tissue to a pre‑filled Bead/Bug homogenizer microtube, add ATL Lysis buffer at 10 volumes per tissue mass (≈1–2 mL; e.g., 100 mg tissue + 1 mL Buffer ATL), and insert 3 mm stainless‑steel beads for soft tissues or 5 mm beads for hard tissues.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K to the tube (use 40 µL if the tissue was stabilized in RNAlater).

steps.title: Homogenize tissue lysate
steps.instruction: Homogenize at maximum speed for 60 s per cycle, placing the tube on ice for 30 s between cycles; repeat 2–3 cycles as needed, avoiding longer times to prevent DNA shearing. Briefly centrifuge the tube to collect debris at the bottom.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL and ethanol
steps.instruction: Add Buffer AL (200 µL; use 220 µL if RNAlater‑stabilized) and vortex thoroughly, then add 200 µL 96–100 % ethanol and vortex again. Immediately centrifuge the 2 mL microtube briefly to remove drops from the lid.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL Buffer AL (220 µL if RNAlater) and vortex vigorously.
Add 200 µL ethanol (96–100 %) and vortex vigorously.
Centrifuge the microtube briefly to remove drops from the lid.

steps.title: Optional RNase treatment
steps.instruction: If RNA‑free DNA is required, add 4 µL RNase (100 mg/mL) and incubate 5 min at room temperature before proceeding.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Place a DNeasy Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube, load the entire mixture (including any precipitate), centrifuge ≥6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 min, then discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Place DNeasy Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Load the whole lysate (including precipitate) onto the column.
Centrifuge at ≥6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.
Discard flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, centrifuge ≥6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 min, and discard the flow‑through and tube.

substeps.instruction: Place column in a new 2 mL collection tube.
Add 500 µL Buffer AW1.
Centrifuge at ≥6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.
Discard flow‑through and tube.

steps.title: Dry column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the column in a fresh 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge 3 min at 20,000 × g (14,000 rpm), discard the flow‑through and tube, and ensure no ethanol carry‑over (repeat 1 min at 20,000 × g if needed).

substeps.instruction: Place column in a fresh 2 mL collection tube.
Add 500 µL Buffer AW2.
Centrifuge for 3 min at 20,000 × g (14,000 rpm).
Discard flow‑through and tube.
If ethanol carry‑over is observed, repeat centrifugation for 1 min at 20,000 × g.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Place the column in a clean 1.5 mL or 2 mL tube, add 200 µL Buffer AE directly onto the membrane, incubate 1 min at room temperature, centrifuge ≥6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 min, and optionally repeat elution (using a new tube or the same) for higher yield, not exceeding 200 µL total in a 1.5 mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Place column in a clean 1.5 mL or 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 200 µL Buffer AE onto the membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 min.
Centrifuge at ≥6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 min to elute.
Optionally repeat elution once (use new tube or reuse; do not exceed 200 µL total in a 1.5 mL tube).

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Determine genomic DNA concentration using a Qubit fluorometer according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Assess DNA purity
steps.instruction: Measure A260/280 and A260/230 ratios with a NanoDrop spectrophotometer to assess DNA purity.
